verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question to ask of a SaaS expense and finance platform, so the axis applies. However, every piece of evidence describes Ramp as a hosted service: remote MCP servers at mcp.ramp.com, a cloud API and sandbox, and SaaS delivery. The open-source CLI is only a client for that hosted service, and nothing documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core product.
